hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Traverse the original hierarchy while remembering the most recent ancestor visited for each label.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: For each vertex, rewire its parent to the closest ancestor carrying the exact same character if one exists.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Once new parent links are established simultaneously, perform a bottom-up traversal on the updated structure to compute subtree sizes.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(n) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n) complexity.
